rules.sentence: Pseudotumor cerebri, characterized by increased intracranial pressure, can present with symptoms similar to those of brain tumors and rhinocerebral mucormycosis, including headache, dizziness, nausea, and visual disturbances.

Pseudotumor cerebri, characterized by increased intracranial pressure, can present with symptoms similar to those of brain tumors and rhinocerebral mucormycosis, including headache, dizziness, nausea, and visual disturbances.
Mucormycosis is a recognized cause of cavernous sinus thrombosis.
